event.summary: Andco introduced Provider Routing by Andco.

evidence.title: Introducing Provider Routing by Andco.
evidence.excerpt: Introducing Provider Routing by Andco. Every firm has some version of it: a spreadsheet of go-to providers, notes on Post-its, a file named providers_v3_FINAL_updated.xlsx. We're replacing that. Andco's provider routing database is now open. Share your provider contact list - any format, we'll do the cleanup - and you get access to our vetted database: verified contacts for where to send records requests, whatever the department or organization. When you're ready to stop looking things up…
